name: Demographic and Health Surveys
description: The Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS) Program spans more than 90 countries and 450+ nationally representative household surveys on population, health, and nutrition. This MCP enables AI tools to query the DHS Program's public aggregate-indicator API to answer questions on fertility, mortality, maternal and child health, nutrition, family planning, and more. Results can be disaggregated by sex, age, residence, and wealth. No individual-level survey records are exposed; microdata access remains governed by DHS's existing registration flow. All results include appropriate citation (survey, country, year).

_published_faq.name: How do I add Demographic and Health Surveys to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Demographic and Health Surveys to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.dhsprogram.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Demographic and Health Surveys MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Demographic and Health Surveys lists 14 MCP tools, including list_dhs_countries, list_dhs_surveys, list_dhs_indicators, search_dhs_indicators_by_text, get_dhs_indicator_profile, list_dhs_tags, list_dhs_survey_characteristics, resolve_dhs_filters, search_dhs_indicator_data, get_dhs_data_availability, list_dhs_datasets, and list_dhs_publications.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Demographic and Health Surveys?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Demographic and Health Surveys in health on the Manufact MCP catalog include CMS Coverage, NPI Registry, AllTrails MCP Server, ICD-10 Codes, and PopHIVE.

_published_faq.name: Does Demographic and Health Surveys MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Demographic and Health Surveys requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Demographic and Health Surveys?

acceptedAnswer.text: Demographic and Health Surveys is developed by ICF. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
